events.headline: CONSTRUCTION
events.description: Road construction. Starting Tue Jul 14. From 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM PST on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. Watch for traffic control. Speed Limit restriction: 50 kmh. Bus on Shoulder project. No impact during day. Periodic night work with 5min stoppages. I. More info: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=4143D59BD46A4DA6B1DD9F3A2D99C5F0.
